claim_boundary: The five target futures were previously opened. This diagnostic may define a future protocol but cannot establish an independent SOTA result.

families.incumbent: released PhysTwin trajectory followed by its frozen validation-selected Bayesian-anchor/last-residual overlay
families.proposal: prefix-gated MatPhys spring proposal replayed in pinned upstream PhysTwin, followed by the same frozen overlay

within_family_selection: minimum balanced validation score among raw backbone, Bayesian anchor, and last residual

cross_family_selection.score: equal mean of validation CD and track ratios to the incumbent raw backbone

simulation_stability_gate.identity_control: zero-change pinned Warp replay under the same known action
simulation_stability_gate.observation_access: none; full simulated trajectories and known actions only
simulation_stability_gate.threshold_status: exploratory threshold to freeze or recalibrate on source-only replays before independent evaluation

independent_requirement: Grouped out-of-fold spring proposals and a frozen source-derived stability threshold over the complete 22-case benchmark, or a separately sealed external cohort.
